## File: facebookresearch_flowmatching/docs/custom_directives.py

Prompts

```
['review the BaseShield class run method that generates shield badge images from img.shields.io', 'review the SupportedDevices directive that renders a devices badge for CPU and CUDA support', 'review the SupportedProperties directive that renders a properties badge for Autograd and TorchScript support', 'review the CustomCardItem directive that renders tutorial card HTML with header, link, description, and tags', 'review the _parse_devices and _parse_properties helper functions that validate and format device and property arguments']
```

```

```
